evidenceClass: Partial D14 SQLite corruption classification evidence; not full effect-drain, capacity-reservation, G1, or H1 qualification.

capturedSource.baseArchive: Git archive of the supervisor source at baseCommit
capturedSource.sourceManifestScope: Workflow recovery package files from the private base archive plus the two owned overlays, along with base archive, go.mod, and go.sum hashes.

change: Wrap SQLite PingContext/open failures with ErrOwnerStore while preserving the underlying SQLite error via multiple %w. The shared open path covers both the SQLite owner and protected root.

test.name: TestSQLiteOwnerRealCorruptionFailsClosedAfterReservedEffect

cases.seed: A child process creates and initializes the real protected root and SQLite owner, registers the initial transcript, durably reserves an effect, checkpoints both databases, and exits.
cases.positiveControl: A separate child reopens the intact files, observes the pending reservation, and verifies that the next ReserveEffect returns ErrPendingUnknown with the test-local grant callback count at zero.
cases.fault: After checkpoint and close, mutate byte zero of the owner database header from S to X; require no WAL sidecar that could recover or hide the corruption.
cases.freshProcessResult: A new child confirms PRAGMA quick_check returns an actual SQLite error with primary code 26 (SQLITE_NOTADB), then requires open rejection classified by ErrOwnerStore or ErrRollback while preserving the SQLite error for errors.As. No grant callback runs.

cases.seed: Same durable reserved-effect fixture and clean-reopen control.
cases.fault: After checkpoint and close, mutate byte zero of the protected-root database header from S to X; require no WAL sidecar that could recover or hide the corruption.
cases.freshProcessResult: A new child confirms PRAGMA quick_check returns an actual SQLite error with primary code 26 (SQLITE_NOTADB), then requires protected-root/owner open rejection classified by ErrOwnerStore or ErrRollback while preserving the SQLite error for errors.As. No grant callback runs.

limitations: The callback counter is a test-local next-grant gate; the test does not invoke production RunEffect, a full binder/drain flow, or a real external effect/provider.

This evidence validates corruption rejection and typed error classification only. It does not establish D14 completion, reserved-capacity behavior, genuine fsync failure, power-loss behavior, or host qualification.

redBaseline.result: On the base production source with the same regression test overlay, both real-corruption cases fail because open returns the raw SQLite NOTADB error without ErrOwnerStore/ErrRollback classification. The positive controls pass and SQLite reports primary code 26.

environment.moduleNetwork: GOPROXY=off and GOSUMDB=off; private GOCACHE and TMPDIR were used.
environment.sourceIsolation: Runs used a private Git archive of baseCommit plus only the two listed owned overlays; concurrent capacity work was excluded.
